parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f( x ) for values of x between − 5 and 5. [2]

content.tex: On the diagram, sketch the graph of \(y =\) f(\(x)\) for values of \(x\) between \(-5\) and 5.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) On the same diagram, sketch the graph of y = g( x ) for values of x between − 5 and 5. [2]

content.tex: On the same diagram, sketch the graph of \(y =\) g(\(x)\) for values of \(x\) between \(-5\) and 5.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps the graph of \(y =\) f(\(x)\) onto the graph of \(y =\) g(\(x).\)
